The year '''1092 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Births==
*The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gub Tengo]] is born.<ref name="GubTengoBirthYear">Page 1 of the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] mentions that Gub Tengo is sixty years old during the events of the novel. As the [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], this places Tengo's birth date in 1092 BBY.</ref>
